# Tallyard

> Free calculators and guides for home-improvement planning. Each page describes its own inputs, assumptions, and limits.

Site: https://www.tallyard.com

There are 50 calculators and worksheets, 6 reference and buying guides, and 10 project-cost guides. Tools vary in scope. Verify product coverage, project conditions, and local requirements before relying on an estimate.

## Calculators and worksheets

- [Paint Calculator](https://www.tallyard.com/paint-calculator): Every formula public. Every source cited. Know exactly what you need before you go to the store.
- [Concrete Calculator](https://www.tallyard.com/concrete-calculator): Cubic yards of concrete for slabs, footings, and round pours. Waste factor included so your order matches your project.
- [Tile Calculator](https://www.tallyard.com/tile-calculator): Tiles and boxes needed for any floor or wall. Accounts for cuts, waste, and patterns so you only make one trip to the store.
- [Mulch Calculator](https://www.tallyard.com/mulch-calculator): Cubic yards of mulch for any garden bed. Shows bag count if you're buying in bags, and bulk yardage if you're ordering by the truck.
- [Drywall Calculator](https://www.tallyard.com/drywall-calculator): Sheets of drywall needed for any room or wall. Accounts for waste, cuts, and standard sheet sizes so you buy once.
- [Roofing Calculator](https://www.tallyard.com/roofing-calculator): Shingles and squares of roofing for any pitch and footprint. Accounts for waste, ridge caps, and the slope multiplier.
- [BTU Calculator](https://www.tallyard.com/btu-calculator): Air conditioner BTU size for any room. Accounts for climate, insulation, sun exposure, and occupancy so you buy the right unit.
- [Gravel Calculator](https://www.tallyard.com/gravel-calculator): Cubic yards of gravel, stone, or aggregate for driveways, paths, or base layers. Converts to tons for bulk ordering.
- [Solar Panel Calculator](https://www.tallyard.com/solar-calculator): Solar system size for your electricity usage. Accounts for sun hours by region, panel wattage, and system losses so you size right the first time.
- [Wire Size Calculator](https://www.tallyard.com/wire-size-calculator): Compare electrical wire gauge (AWG) against the listed ampacity and voltage-drop assumptions for an entered load and run length. This limited worksheet does not establish complete installation code compliance.
- [Insulation Calculator](https://www.tallyard.com/insulation-calculator): R-value and square footage of insulation for any wall, attic, or floor. Rolls or batts, with climate-appropriate R-value recommendations.
- [Fence Calculator](https://www.tallyard.com/fence-calculator): Posts, rails, and pickets for any fence length. Includes concrete for post holes and accounts for gates and corners.
- [Grout Calculator](https://www.tallyard.com/grout-calculator): Pounds of grout for any tile installation. Accounts for tile size, joint width, and thickness so you buy the right bags.
- [Paver Calculator](https://www.tallyard.com/paver-calculator): Pavers, base gravel, and sand for any patio or path. Accounts for cuts, pattern waste, and the underlying base layers.
- [Deck Calculator](https://www.tallyard.com/deck-calculator): Deck boards, joists, beams, and fasteners for any size deck. Accounts for board width, joist spacing, and the support frame.
- [Flooring Calculator](https://www.tallyard.com/flooring-calculator): Square footage and box count for hardwood, laminate, or vinyl plank. Accounts for the industry-standard 10% waste and pattern cuts.
- [Topsoil Calculator](https://www.tallyard.com/topsoil-calculator): Cubic yards of topsoil or fill dirt for any garden bed, lawn, or fill project. Converts to bags for small jobs and tons for delivery.
- [Sod Calculator](https://www.tallyard.com/sod-calculator): Square footage, rolls, and pallets of sod for any lawn. Accounts for cuts and waste so you can finish installation in one day.
- [Asphalt Calculator](https://www.tallyard.com/asphalt-calculator): Tons of asphalt for any driveway or parking area. Accounts for typical 145 lb/ft³ density and standard compaction depths.
- [Lumber Calculator](https://www.tallyard.com/lumber-calculator): Board feet and lineal feet for any lumber order. Handles nominal sizes (2×4, 2×6, etc.) and quantities for framing, decks, and projects.
- [Stair Calculator](https://www.tallyard.com/stair-calculator): Stair stringer length, rise, run, and tread count for any height. Meets IRC code limits on rise and tread dimensions.
- [Rebar Calculator](https://www.tallyard.com/rebar-calculator): Rebar lineal feet and pieces for any concrete slab. Standard grid spacing, with overlap for continuous runs.
- [Brick Calculator](https://www.tallyard.com/brick-calculator): Bricks and mortar bags for any wall or project. Accounts for brick size, mortar joint width, and typical 10% cut waste.
- [Wallpaper Calculator](https://www.tallyard.com/wallpaper-calculator): Rolls of wallpaper for any room. Accounts for pattern repeat, roll coverage, and typical 15% cut waste so you buy exactly what you need.
- [Shower Tile Calculator](https://www.tallyard.com/shower-tile-calculator): Tiles and boxes for a shower or tub surround. Calculates three walls plus optional niche and floor, with cut waste built in.
- [Backsplash Calculator](https://www.tallyard.com/backsplash-calculator): Tiles and boxes for a kitchen backsplash. Accounts for window cutouts, outlet openings, and the 15% cut waste typical of backsplashes.
- [Vanity Calculator](https://www.tallyard.com/vanity-calculator): Right-size a bathroom vanity for your space. Standard sizes, clearance requirements, and single vs. double sink guidance.
- [Countertop Calculator](https://www.tallyard.com/countertop-calculator): Square feet and linear feet of countertop for any kitchen or bath. Accounts for standard depth, waste, and edge treatments.
- [Siding Calculator](https://www.tallyard.com/siding-calculator): Squares and linear feet of siding for any house. Accounts for gables, openings, and typical 10-15% waste by material type.
- [Gutter Calculator](https://www.tallyard.com/gutter-calculator): Linear feet of gutter, downspouts, and accessories for any home. Sizes gutters for your roof area and rainfall intensity.
- [Heat Pump Calculator](https://www.tallyard.com/heat-pump-calculator): Explore an illustrative heat-pump load estimate from home area, climate and insulation assumptions. This rule-of-thumb scenario is not Manual J or an equipment selection.
- [Water Heater Calculator](https://www.tallyard.com/water-heater-calculator): Right-size a tank or tankless water heater for your household. Based on peak-hour demand, fixture count, and household size.
- [Extension Cord Calculator](https://www.tallyard.com/extension-cord-calculator): Right extension cord gauge for any tool, appliance, or outdoor device. Accounts for amps, length, and voltage drop.
- [Attic Ventilation Calculator](https://www.tallyard.com/attic-ventilation-calculator): Square inches of intake and exhaust attic venting needed. Follows the 1:300 rule with 50/50 balanced intake and exhaust.
- [Pool Chlorine Calculator](https://www.tallyard.com/pool-chlorine-calculator): Estimate chlorine product mass from pool volume, measured free chlorine, an entered target and exact label strength. Optional liquid volume uses entered product density; not a treatment recommendation.
- [Shed Calculator](https://www.tallyard.com/shed-calculator): Materials for any backyard shed: floor, walls, roof sheathing, and siding. Sized by shed footprint and wall height.
- [Rainwater Harvesting Calculator](https://www.tallyard.com/rainwater-calculator): Gallons of rainwater you can collect from your roof. Sizes barrels and tanks for any roof area and annual rainfall.
- [Snow Load Calculator](https://www.tallyard.com/snow-load-calculator): Estimate snow and ice weight from depth, roof area and illustrative density assumptions. A selected reference pressure is not your roof's verified structural capacity.
- [Stud Spacing Calculator](https://www.tallyard.com/stud-spacing-calculator): Estimate line studs and illustrative extra studs for entered corners, doors and windows. Header design and complete structural/code compliance are not assessed.
- [Drain Pipe Calculator](https://www.tallyard.com/drain-pipe-calculator): Drain pipe size by fixture count. Uses DFU (drainage fixture units) per IPC / UPC codes to pick the right pipe diameter for any bathroom or kitchen branch.
- [Kitchen Cabinet Calculator](https://www.tallyard.com/kitchen-cabinet-calculator): Linear feet of upper and base cabinets for any kitchen. Budget and cabinet count by kitchen size and layout.
- [Garage Door Calculator](https://www.tallyard.com/garage-door-calculator): Right garage door size, headroom, and opener power for any garage. Checks clearances and recommends single vs double door.
- [Window Sizing Calculator](https://www.tallyard.com/window-sizing-calculator): Right window size for any room. Checks code-required egress, natural light minimums, and recommends rough opening dimensions.
- [Chimney Calculator](https://www.tallyard.com/chimney-calculator): Flue size for fireplaces and wood stoves. Uses the 1/10 rule for masonry fireplaces and appliance-specific sizing for stoves and inserts.
- [Mortar Calculator](https://www.tallyard.com/mortar-calculator): Bags of mortar mix for brick, block, and stone walls. Accounts for joint width, brick size, and mortar type so you order the right amount.
- [Furnace Replacement Cost Calculator](https://www.tallyard.com/furnace-replacement-cost-calculator): Installed cost to replace a furnace, with or without central AC. Priced by furnace type, efficiency, home size, and install complexity, with the full breakdown shown.
- [Egress Window Calculator](https://www.tallyard.com/egress-window-calculator): Compare entered net-clear width, height, opening area and sill height with the listed IRC reference dimensions. This partial comparison is not complete code compliance or an installation approval.
- [Deck Stair Calculator](https://www.tallyard.com/deck-stair-calculator): Stringer layout for deck stairs: riser height, tread run, stringer length, and board counts, checked against IRC R311.7 with a printable dimensioned cut sheet.
- [Hardwood Flooring Cost Calculator](https://www.tallyard.com/hardwood-flooring-cost-calculator): Installed cost of hardwood flooring by species, solid or engineered, and installation method, with material and labor itemized and the waste factor shown.
- [Hardwood Floor Refinishing Cost Calculator](https://www.tallyard.com/hardwood-floor-refinishing-cost-calculator): Cost to sand and refinish hardwood floors by area, finish type, and condition, with the screen-and-recoat alternative priced alongside a full sand.

## Guides

- [Vinyl vs fiber cement siding: the real 30-year cost](https://www.tallyard.com/guides/vinyl-vs-fiber-cement-siding): Honest comparison of vinyl and fiber cement siding with 30-year TCO math, fire performance data, and installation guidance.
- [Composite vs pressure-treated vs cedar decking: 20-year cost breakdown](https://www.tallyard.com/guides/composite-vs-pressure-treated-vs-cedar-deck): Real 20-year total cost of ownership for composite, pressure-treated, and cedar decking. Maintenance cycles, climate suitability, and when each material wins.
- [Heat pump vs furnace + AC: which wins in your climate?](https://www.tallyard.com/guides/heat-pump-vs-furnace): Climate-zone-by-zone comparison of heat pump vs gas furnace + AC. Install cost, 15-year operating cost, federal tax credits, cold-climate performance data.
- [Construction Waste Factor Reference: Every Material, One Table](https://www.tallyard.com/guides/waste-factor-reference): Waste factor percentages for tile, flooring, drywall, roofing, siding, concrete, and more, with the reason behind each number and when to go higher or lower.
- [Residential Building Code Limits: IRC Quick Reference Table](https://www.tallyard.com/guides/residential-code-limits-reference): Every IRC dimensional limit builders check: stair risers and treads, guards, handrails, egress openings, ceiling heights, and attic access, each with its code section.
- [Joist Span Reference: Floor, Deck, and Header Planning Spans](https://www.tallyard.com/guides/joist-span-reference): Conservative planning spans for floor joists, deck joists, and headers, plus the five variables that set any span and the IRC notching limits that void one.

Project-cost guides: https://www.tallyard.com/guides
Methodology and limitations: https://www.tallyard.com/methodology
Detailed calculator descriptions: https://www.tallyard.com/llms-full.txt
